notes: Home on wide screens is a balanced grid that follows your Arrange Home order, with related sections side by side
Home greets you with today's date, shows what needs attention under it, and splits net worth into what you own and owe
For you today shows as a full grid on wide screens; Coming up is a card with its total, and Recent shows five
Money, Wealth, Plan, Yearly budget, Portfolio mix and Settings use the width of wide screens better
Headline figures count up when shown and roll to their new value after a change
On phones, slide a Money history row left to edit or delete it
Each category has its own colour in history and recent entries
Drag along the net worth line or across the income bars to read each month
Pop-ups on phones open part way and snap to full height from the handle, a drag up or scrolling
Sections rise in as a page opens, and Wealth's category cards grow into their page
Arrange Home: hide sections and, on phones, reorder them, from the button beside the greeting
Each tab's colour glow now works in every theme
